title: check.code@1
description: The check catalog's codes: the one source of the findings a check run can carry about how it ran, each mapped to a verdict. exit_masked: the command's exit status is masked, so it can't fail. no_tests_ran: a run of zero tests. crashed_before_first_assertion: the suite crashed before its first assertion ran. reported_after_deadline: a result reported after the run's deadline. output_dropped: a crashed run's output was dropped. type_error_as_assertion: a TypeError thrown before the first assertion was reported as an assertion failure.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of the check catalog; each code names a row of the verdict table
